prompt: Find promising narrative recombinations for a mid-budget original film. Use the database yourself: start broad, cite sample counts, and do not invent columns or vocabulary terms.

proposal.title: The Unveiling of Echoes
proposal.logline: A disillusioned mentor and a young, reluctant hero uncover a vast hidden conspiracy that forces them to confront a profound loss of innocence, challenging everything they believed about their world.
proposal.rationale: This proposal combines the highly successful motif pair of 'hidden_conspiracy' and 'loss_of_innocence', which demonstrated the highest median ROI and interest cohort percentile in the analysis. Supporting this core narrative are the 'reluctant_hero' and 'mentor' archetypes, both of which consistently show strong financial returns and sustained audience interest across the dataset, providing a robust foundation for character engagement. The classic three-act structure provides a proven narrative framework for this compelling combination.

caveats: Analogues were drawn from the mid budget band. The proposal has no budget of its own; this band was assumed for the comparison.
Analogues span 1990-2014 with no era filter. The dataset ends at 2014 because the plot corpus does, not because later films were excluded.
Attention reflects sustained Wikipedia lookups from 2015 onward, measured 1-25 years after release. It is not opening-weekend attention.
The interest figures reflect sustained attention years after release, as the measurement window began in 2015, long after these films were released.
The mid-budget analysis is limited to films with budgets between $20,000,000 and $80,000,000 USD.

proposal.title: Echoes of the Wronged
proposal.logline: When a lone witness is framed for a crime they only saw, they must navigate a corrupted system to clear their name and protect vulnerable innocents caught in the crossfire.
proposal.rationale: This combination of motifs and archetypes was selected as a wildcard proposal because the provided Phase A analysis transcript did not present any data or insights on their performance, either individually or in combination, regarding ROI or audience interest. The motifs 'wrongful_accusation' and 'man_versus_system,' and the archetypes 'orphan' and 'witness,' were not highlighted among the top-performing elements or discussed in terms of their profitability or sustained audience engagement. Therefore, this proposal lacks direct empirical support from the provided dataset.
